It computes `round_idx = len(raw_counts) - 1` and compares that zero-based value to `cfg.rho_earliest_round`, which elsewhere is configured and logged as human round numbers (`earliest_stop_round`, default 12).     source_code: str, model_configs: List[ModelConfig],

    if round_idx < cfg.verification_min_round:
